entities.name: Takeshi Konda
entities.description: One of the greatest human rulers of Kamigawa, who resided in Eiganjo and committed the crime that triggered the Kami War.

entities.name: Lady Yoshino
entities.description: Konda's favorite concubine who died giving birth to Michiko.

entities.name: Michiko Konda
entities.description: Konda's daughter who struck him down.

entities.name: Eight-and-a-Half-Tails
entities.description: Researcher whose results aided Konda's ritual.

entities.name: Meloku
entities.description: Soratami ambassador who participated in the ritual.

entities.name: O-Kagachi
entities.description: Major spirit, a part of whom Konda imprisoned.

entities.name: Kyodai
entities.description: Spirit captured by Konda who later struck down O-Kagachi and petrified Konda.

entities.name: Kami War
entities.description: Twenty-year conflict between Kamigawa's mortal and spiritual worlds.

events.summary: As a young man Konda built Eiganjo Castle, drove out bandits and united local warlords.
events.quote: Konda built Eiganjo Castle , drove out the surrounding bandits

events.summary: Konda performed a sacrilegious ritual breaking the barrier between mortal and spirit worlds and imprisoned a major spirit, gaining immortality.
events.quote: he broke the barrier between the mortal and spirit worlds

events.summary: Konda's crime triggered the Kami War.
events.quote: Konda's crime triggered the Kami War

events.summary: At the climax of the war Konda and O-Kagachi were struck down by their daughters Michiko and Kyodai.
events.quote: Konda and O-Kagachi were struck down by their daughters

events.summary: The Taken One punctured Konda's eyes, petrified him and crushed him into a million pieces.
events.quote: the Taken One punctured Konda's eyes, then petrified his immortal body and crushed him into a million pieces
